adjudication.rationale: In EventManager.ts (~493-560) the code was changed to handle multiple calendar references by pushing multiple `updateEvent(...)` calls into a single `result` array inside one try/catch. This implies the function will later await these together (it must, since the function returns `Promise<Array<EventResult<...>>>`, not `Promise<Promise<...>[]>`). If these are awaited via `Promise.all(result)` (consistent with the surrounding patterns), then any single `updateEvent` rejection would throw into the catch, which now returns a synthesized failure result for *every* reference (`calendarReference?.map(...)`), thereby discarding any successful updates and creating external-calendar/DB desync—exactly the all-or-nothing failure described.
